Messages.Body:
Hi all I am sure that this has been offically answered but I am asking for
"offical" answers for the few in my group who won't take the elders word for
it.

Does the extra master phase that coven gives continue around the table or
just the 2 pool transfer effect??

Thx

Errol

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
"Errol" <bigsu...@home.com> writes:

> Does the extra master phase that coven gives continue around the table or
> just the 2 pool transfer effect??

Coven gives the person who plays it one extra master phase action when
they play it, and nothing more. The extra MPA doesn't carry on to
anyone else, at all.

Messages.Author: Xian
Messages.Body:
"NephandusMage" <nephan...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:3a9c5...@news5.newsfeeds.com...

> So does the playing Meth. get or not get the extra Master Phase each turn,
> as long as the card is still in play?

From the official online text
(http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_C.html#Coven):

The Coven [SW]
Cardtype: Master
Unique Master. Gain a master phase action and put this card into play. Tap to
move two blood from the blood bank to a ready vampire you control. At the end
of your turn, your predator takes control of The Coven.

You gain a master phase action for *this turn only*.

Xian

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Xian wrote:
> "NephandusMage" <nephan...@yahoo.com> wrote in message

> > So does the playing Meth. get or not get the extra Master Phase each
> > turn, as long as the card is still in play?

> You gain a master phase action for *this turn only*.

Correct. You gain the MPA when you put the card in play (from your
hand, as your Master Phase Action), and not at any other additional
time.


